question.html:
During a hail storm spherical pieces of ice (hailstones) fall towards the surface of the Earth. The following data is given:

Specific heat capacity of water: kJ kg K

Specific heat capacity of ice: kJ kg K

Specific latent heat of fusion of ice: kJ kg

Density of ice: kg m

Initial temperature of ice: C

Radius of a hailstone: cm

a. Calculate the mass of a hailstone. Give your answer to an appropriate number of significant figures.

  [2]

As the hailstone falls, % of the hailstone’s initial gravitational potential energy is converted into the internal energy of the hailstone. After the hailstone falls through a vertical distance of , its temperature increases by C.

When the hailstone reaches the surface of the Earth it falls into a puddle. The temperature of the hailstone at this moment is C. The mass of the water in the puddle is kg and the initial temperature of the water in the puddle is C.
